signal: Filevine raised $400M in 2025 and launched its Legal Operating Intelligence System (LOIS) console in June 2026

email.body1:
Tanner, saw Filevine raised $400M and just launched the LOIS console to run AI agents across whole firms.

Scaling a category like that usually means more in-market firms in play than your reps can cover before quota resets, and that is where good accounts go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Filevine off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Tanner, quick follow-up for Filevine.

After a raise that size, board expectations on pipeline jump faster than you can ramp reps, and most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit the new number. The gap tends to surface late, when recovering the quarter is already a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Filevine needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Tanner, last bit of proof for Filevine.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Filevine's reply rate likely compares to other fast-scaling software companies. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Tanner, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem. Timing matters most right after a raise, and I know the post-funding stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a legal-tech motion? I will tailor it to Filevine either way.
